# Bid the doors, the drawers, and the degrease — not the door count.

> Price a kitchen cabinet refinish from doors, drawer fronts, face frames, hardware, degrease, and a dark-to-light extra coat — then see price per door, price per painted piece, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
